Please help us complete it.Problems and Purpose"The Children's Council is currently made up of 40 boys and girls from the 5th grade of Primary Education; each of them represents their classmates from the Public and Concerted Primary Education Centers of Móstoles.The Children's Council is divided into two Work Commissions, according to the educational zone to which the educational center in which they study belongs.The summons to the meetings will be made once a month, by letter and e-mail that is sent to your address in the name of the Director; It will indicate the date, place and time, as well as the order of the day and the topics to be discussed.
